name: Innistrad's moon
description: The silver moon where the Helvault came from; it becomes Emrakul's prison, branded with the glyph.

timeline.summary: A silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul toward it until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

timeline.summary: Liliana, having survived, stares at the moon and curses Emrakul to rot there forever.

relations.note: After the binding, Emrakul is sealed in the moon's depths.
relations.quote: In that moon's depths was the most powerful and destructive force any of them had ever encountered.
